title: I've met someone in my mall (?)
content: I found this sub randomly in my feed, but upon reading the premise/reason it was founded I knew I had to post at least once. I have a couple malls (or they may be the same one, just different floors, am not certain). But this is about **meeting someone in them**. In a few dreams I'va had I walk up from a large parking lot that opens directly into the mall (concrete right into tile, no outside showing). I'm with my mother and grandfather (who passed a long time ago) in these, but we split up. I *know* I'm here to meet someone and I know who it is - a person that I call "Zoro" that looks like the anime character of the same name. I know, again, that it's not a character. It's a person that is likely using him as an avatar of sorts, like how I look in my dreams (purple hair, cat ears, striped tail split at the tip). I head over to the carpeted kids play area and there he is. I think we just wander around, crawling through tunnels (adult sized, carpeted, not kid ones) and looking at the liminal spaces in wonder, until I wake up. But I have the very strong feeling that he's not only my soul mate (sidenote, I'm married and love my husband very much, maybe it's a friend soul mate?) but he's a real person I've met through the dream. It fades in time but it's so interesting.
